name: codex-qquse
description: Use a local QQ account and optionally enable per-chat Codex auto-replies through OneBot v11.

interface.shortDescription: Use QQ and configure per-chat auto-replies
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to a local OneBot v11 HTTP endpoint, restore an opted-in NapCat Shell gateway when stopped, read chats, send plain text with approval, and optionally auto-reply in explicitly enabled chats.
defaultPrompt: 查看我的 QQ 连接状态
帮我查找一个 QQ 群并读取最近消息
帮我给 QQ 好友拟一条消息，确认后发送
开启给好友 123456789 的 QQ 自动回复
